entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday that Pierce (heel) will be placed on injured reserve and is without a timeline for a return, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar plans to undergo surgery to repair a broken forearm and is hoping to return from injured reserve when first eligible for the Chargers' Week 8 game against the Rams, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Head coach Jim Harbaugh told reporters Monday that Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) will both go on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: Dart is expected to undergo knee surgery that will end his 2026 season but lead to a full recovery heading into 2027, Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo of NFL Network report.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that the Seahawks are drawing closer to setting a date for Charbonnet (knee) to resume practicing, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that he doesn't anticipate Williams (hamstring) practicing in Week 3, though Johnson was unwilling to officially rule out the quarterback from playing Monday against the Eagles, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) was diagnosed Monday with a sprained MCL and is expected to miss a few weeks, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Daniels (elbow) underwent imaging Monday and will consult with multiple experts over the next few days, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Tuesday that Reed has returned to Green Bay to undergo further testing and consultations with doctors for his neck injury, Ryan Wood of USA Today. The wide receiver remains without a timeline for a return.

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Taylor (thumb) is considered week-to-week and will likely miss Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that it's "too early to tell" the severity of the ankle injury Douglas sustained in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the 49ers, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dareke Young
entries.summary: Young (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: DJ Giddens
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: The Bills are treating Moore as day-to-day after he was diagnosed with an AC joint sprain in his shoulder after exiting Thursday's 41-31 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (thigh) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: The Broncos believe that Dobbins' injured hamstring is "good" heading into next Sunday's game against the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's win at Arizona, but "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like," Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (neck) is day-to-day heading into Week 3, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Malik Nabers
entries.summary: Nabers left Monday's game against the Rams with an apparent right arm injury and is questionable to return, Ralph Vacchiano of FoxSports.com reports.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Pittman (foot) will practice Wednesday and is likely to be a limited participant, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Evans (hip) will "have to be managed this week" leading up to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay acknowledged Tuesday that he's uncertain if Nacua (groin) will be available for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times reports. "I'm not sure what his status is as far as this next coming week," McVay said of Nacua. "I'm hopeful that he'll play.... If he's ready to go, great. If not, then we'll continue to roll."

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle is considered day-to-day after undergoing testing on his toe injury Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: RJ Harvey
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: Rivers has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Giants due to a calf injury.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Darnold (glute) will practice Wednesday, according to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: The Eagles announced that Barkley (neck/shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans due to a stinger.

entries.name: Ty Johnson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Bagent was diagnosed with a concussion and placed in the five-step protocol Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: The Jets placed Smith (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: The 49ers placed Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Coach Jesse Minter said Lane underwent wrist surgery Wednesday, and the Ravens placed the rookie wide receiver on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Brooks (core) on injured reserve Wednesday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: ir
